title: The structural context of mutations in proteins predicts their effect on antibiotic resistance.
authors: Green, Anna G; Tasmin, Mahbuba; Vargas, Roger Jr; Farhat, Maha Reda
one_liner_zh: 该文利用蛋白质结构（含AlphaFold预测）上下文预测结核分枝杆菌耐药突变，虽以表型预测为核心，但结构聚类分析和3D距离分类器对蛋白质结构计算建模有方法学借鉴意义。
abstract: In Mycobacterium tuberculosis, a prevalent and deadly pathogen, resistance to antibiotics evolves primarily through non-synonymous mutations in proteins. Sequence-based analyses can uncover the genetic basis of antibiotic resistance, but these methods focus on primary sequence and often neglect other biological signals, such as protein structural information. We hypothesize that integrating the structural context of mutations improves the prediction of effects on function and phenotype. We curate high-confidence structural annotations for the M. tuberculosis proteome from 1350 crystallography and 2337 AlphaFold predictions, and mutations from over 31,000 M. tuberculosis isolates. We demonstrate that mutations in proteins known to cause resistance are clustered in 3D space, even in proteins where inactivating mutations at any position are thought to cause resistance. We find over 450 proteins in the M. tuberculosis proteome that display signals of clustered mutations, many of which have a known relationship with antibiotic resistance. We show that a supervised classifier trained on 3D distance to known resistance sites alone has an F1 score of 96.5% at classifying mutations as resistance-conferring on a held-out test set. This work demonstrates that protein structure provides useful information for categorizing which variants may cause antibiotic resistance, even when the majority of structures are AI-predicted.
abstract_zh: 在结核分枝杆菌（Mycobacterium tuberculosis）这一普遍且致命的病原体中，抗生素耐药性主要通过蛋白质中的非同义突变演化而来。基于序列的分析可以揭示抗生素耐药性的遗传基础，但这些方法侧重于一级序列，往往忽略其他生物学信号，如蛋白质结构信息。我们假设，整合突变的结构背景能改善对其功能和表型影响的预测。我们从1350个晶体学和2337个AlphaFold预测中，为结核分枝杆菌蛋白质组整理了高置信度的结构注释，并从超过31,000个结核分枝杆菌分离株中获取突变数据。我们证明，已知导致耐药性的蛋白质中的突变在三维空间中聚集，即使在那些被认为任何位置失活突变均可导致耐药性的蛋白质中也是如此。我们在结核分枝杆菌蛋白质组中发现超过450个蛋白质显示出聚集突变信号，其中许多与抗生素耐药性有已知关联。我们展示，仅基于到已知耐药位点的三维距离训练的监督分类器，在保留测试集上将突变分类为赋予耐药性时，F1分数达到96.5%。这项工作表明，蛋白质结构为分类哪些变异可能导致抗生素耐药性提供了有用信息，即使大多数结构是AI预测的。
